legal.disposition: Pleaded guilty to aggravated fleeing and property damage; sentenced to 7 years for fleeing and 4 years for property damage.

event_summary.short: Jasper County deputy pursued 36-year-old Helen Stark after a reported disturbance; she had active felony warrants and led a 25-mile pursuit before being boxed in at a grain farm. She was arrested and later sentenced to 7 years for aggravated fleeing and 4 years for property damage.
